reviewRequired.note: B:evolution is intended,but evolution need not produce a new species. The definition wrongly makes speciation necessary;teacher moderation.
Source draft option includes“WEEK4Content-Not assessed”;retain teacher review rather than auto-assess.

A(environmental resistance)is likely intended,but speciation can also involve genetic drift rather than selection pressure(D). Mechanisms vary;the source does not define a unique necessary-step framework.
Equal masses/initial temperatures are unstated;answer conditional on them.
Thermal conductivity alone does not determine actual temperature or touch sensation after sunshine exposure.
Course-specific recall with no curriculum list provided.
A generic flow diagram can also represent energy transformations;answers overlap.
Word-bank item conflates energy with power;retained for teacher correction.
Corrected supplied key’s missing kinetic energy of the moving balloon/air.
Resultant direction is known but speed change requires velocity direction.
Multiple ticker tapes shown without identifying the target.
This is the source’s stipulated single-gene Mendelian model;real earlobe attachment and tongue rolling are not reliably described as simple one-gene dominant traits.
